text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder looks like she's on<n>the brink of a
burnout, so I bring her<n>to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry you had to go so far out of<n>your way for
me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You should take some time off to rest<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Goodness me. Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer doesn't seem to be here. I<n>wonder what's
around.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that a full tea set? It even<n>includes top-grade
gyokuro tea<n>leaves...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This place is so tranquil, I should take<n>a moment to
relax.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The caress of the breeze... The<n>freshness of the
air... The beautiful<n>sky stretching endlessly above...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now that I've calmed down, I<n>realize how
surprisingly pleasant this<n>place is. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It was an incredible dream. I<n>was in this
lovely place drinking tea.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That must be why I feel so<n>rejuvenated. If only I
could take you<n>there, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her face, I'd say Grass<n>Wonder is back
to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Oh, dear. What happened to the<n>tea?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was certain I was drinking a fresh<n>brew just a
moment ago... But this is<n>the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So it must have all been a strange<n>dream, then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Grass Wonder's nap<n>was less than
restful.
